cs.t: So the D6 is the last DSLR body that will be available. I've been a Nikon shooter for 2 decades now, shooting with the D100, D70, D2S, D2X, D3X, D300, D700, D810 and D850. It's easier to list the Nikon lenses I didn't buy vs the ones I bought... which I didn't buy anything over an F2.8 aperture. This is heart breaking for me. Now Nikon expects me to buy into a new camera and new lens system...
cs.th: Nikon to stop making SLR cameras and focus on mirrorless models?
